openness_notes: LICENSE: a three-clause BSD-style text, 'Copyright (c) 2023, The Regents' (LBNL, DOE), with no commercial-use restriction. Pretrained weights (0.3.0 released 2023-10-22; 0.2.0 kept for the paper; r2SCAN variant) ship with the package. Training data: the Materials Project trajectory dataset MPtrj ('more than 1.5 Million structures from 146k compounds'), hosted on figshare; use implies agreeing to MP terms of use. MPtrj became a standard training set for later MLIPs (MACE-MP-0, SevenNet-0, OMat24 OAM checkpoints). Group I scoring: 0 = no weights; 1 = weights only under non-commercial or gated custom terms; 2 = open code/weights with the flagship model, weights or training data closed (open core); 3 = code and weights under OSI-type or CC BY licences; 4 = 3 plus openly downloadable training data, or outputs published as an open database stewarded by a public institution. Score 4.

license_history.license: BSD-style (UC Regents/LBNL) code and weights; MPtrj on figshare

robustness: Permissive code, public weights and public training data; DOE-lab copyright.
physical_science_relevance: Battery and inorganic materials simulation with magnetic-moment (charge) information.
openness_effect_assessment: CHGNet's most durable contribution may be its training set: MPtrj became the common benchmark training data used by MACE-MP-0, SevenNet-0 and Meta's OAM checkpoints.
key_takeaway: A DOE-lab academic model, fully open in code, weights and data. Publishing the training set multiplied its impact beyond the model itself.
